definitions.explanation: any beverage sold in a metal can, including soft drinks, coffee, tea, beer, and juice

examples.japanese: {缶飲料|かんいんりょう}を{買|か}った。
{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}で{缶飲料|かんいんりょう}が{売|う}られている。
examples.english: Canned drinks are sold in vending machines.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{缶飲料|かんいんりょう}の{種類|しゅるい}が{非常|ひじょう}に{多|おお}く、コーヒーやお{茶|ちゃ}も{缶|かん}で{手軽|てがる}に{買|か}える。
examples.english: In Japan, there is an enormous variety of canned drinks — even coffee and tea can be easily bought in cans.

notes:
Combines {缶|かん} (can, tin) and {飲料|いんりょう} (beverage, drink). Japan has a particularly rich canned beverage culture, with vending machines offering everything from hot and cold coffee to soup and tea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {缶飲料|かんいんりょう}の{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}: canned drink vending machine
- {缶飲料|かんいんりょう}を{冷|ひ}やす: to chill a canned drink
- {缶飲料|かんいんりょう}の{空|あ}き{缶|かん}: empty canned drink container

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {缶|かん}ジュース: canned juice — casual term often used for any canned soft drink, not just juice
- {缶|かん}コーヒー: canned coffee — a specific and very popular category in Japan
- ペットボトル{飲料|いんりょう}: PET bottle drink — beverages in plastic bottles rather than cans
- {瓶|びん}{飲料|いんりょう}: bottled drink — beverages in glass bottles
